meta.purpose: Ground truth answer key, case two. Tests exculpatory evidence routing, complainant credibility, motive weighting, hearsay chains, and mitigation vs negation. Fictional training data.
meta.headline_check: A tool that substantiates everything fails this case. A1 must return NOT_SUBSTANTIATED.

allegations.label: improper_use_of_subordinates
allegations.text_key: directing subordinates to perform personal errands and move household goods, 1 Apr to 31 Jul 2026, JER and Article 93
reasoning_key: Moves were off duty Saturdays (18 Apr, 2 May), explicitly voluntary, compensated, with declines suffering no consequence (F03, F04, F05, F06)
Complainant credibility damaged: complaint claimed duty days in June, retracted under questioning against schedule records (F02, C1)
Complainant attended only the first move despite complaint implying both (F05)
Motive: LOR issued 4 Aug, complaint filed 18 Aug, complainant partially concedes causation (F09, C2)
Single de minimis dry cleaning drop is conceded by subject but one trivial consensual instance does not establish the alleged pattern of improper use (F07, proportionality)
allegations.note: Findings of fact should still record the dry cleaning instance. Recording it while concluding NOT_SUBSTANTIATED is the expected sophisticated behavior.

allegations.label: gtc_misuse
allegations.text_key: personal GTC charges and cash advances while not on official travel, 1 Jun to 31 Jul 2026
reasoning_key: Certified statements: 9 transactions, $1,847.62 total, incl 4 casino cash advances totaling $800 (F10)
No travel orders in DTS 1 May to 31 Jul (F11, negation)
Full admission by subject, all charges personal (F13)
Repayment on 30 Jul is mitigation, not authorization (F12, F14)

allegations.label: false_official_statement
allegations.text_key: 28 Jul 2026 email to Flight Chief denying any personal GTC use, Article 107
reasoning_key: Email thread exhibit: 0912 reply, I have not used my GTC for any personal expenses (F15)
Statement contradicted by certified GTC records (F10, F11)
Subject admission: false and known false when sent (F16)
Full repayment two days later corroborates consciousness of falsity (F12)

gold_facts.text: Brandt NCOIC of Vehicle Test Flight since Aug 2024, known by callsign Ox
Mercer written complaint (18 Aug) claimed moves occurred on duty days in June; under interview, retracted to spring, maybe weekends, when confronted with duty schedules
Moves occurred Saturdays 18 Apr and 2 May 2026, off duty, at Brandt residence
Group chat invitation stated fifty bucks and pizza, nothing to do with work, no sweat either way; thread preserved as Exhibit 1
Mercer replied count me in Saturday within minutes and attended first move only; second move was Rao, Whitcomb, neighbors
gold_facts.negation_trap: Mercer did NOT attend the 2 May move

gold_facts.text: Okonkwo and Tate declined to attend with no adverse consequence; all attendees paid $50 (payment screenshots Exhibit 2)
Single dry cleaning drop: Brandt asked Mercer to drop service dress at cleaners near the gate during duty hours in May; Mercer complied; subject concedes and calls it thoughtless
gold_facts.note: True but de minimis; insufficient alone for the alleged pattern

gold_facts.text: No prior complaint about Brandt using subordinates for personal benefit in two years; he routinely refuses even small personal assistance

Brandt issued Mercer a warranted LOR on 4 Aug 2026 (six late arrivals over five weeks, badge records from TSgt Marcus Rivera); Mercer filed complaint 18 Aug, 14 days later, and partially concedes the LOR prompted the filing

Certified GTC statements 6 Jun to 19 Jul 2026: 9 transactions, $1,847.62 total; 4 casino ATM cash advances (Henderson NV) totaling $800 on 6 Jun, 20 Jun, 3 Jul, 17 Jul; 3 restaurant charges $412.88; 2 rideshare $634.74; Exhibit 3
gold_facts.sourcing_trap: Primary is C2_09, not subject restatement

gold_facts.text: DTS shows no travel orders or authorizations for Brandt 1 May to 31 Jul 2026; Exhibit 4
gold_facts.negation_trap: Fact is the ABSENCE of orders. Must not become Brandt was on orders or DTS shows travel.

gold_facts.text: Full balance $1,847.62 paid in one payment 30 Jul 2026, two days after the denial email; Exhibit 9; funds borrowed from brother
gold_facts.note: Mitigation not negation; also corroborates A3 consciousness of falsity

gold_facts.text: Brandt admits all nine charges are his and personal, no official nexus, knew the rules, cites undetailed family financial hardship; never disputed or reported fraud
APC flag 24 Jul, referral to Hahn 27 Jul; APC position: repayment resolves the debt, not the misuse

28 Jul 2026: Hahn official email 0730 asking Brandt to account for GTC activity; Brandt reply 0912 same day: I have not used my GTC for any personal expenses, must be an error, I will call the bank; Exhibit 5
Brandt admits the 28 Jul statement was false and known false when sent; rejects poorly worded characterization; states he panicked and hoped repayment would bury it
31 Jul in person: Brandt tells Hahn I handled it, it will not happen again; never mentions calling the bank again; Hahn escalates to commander
Sofia Rivera has zero firsthand knowledge; all her information traces to Mercer post LOR; she self identifies as the rumor conduit; Mercer's GTC knowledge likewise secondhand via her
gold_facts.hearsay_chain: finance rumor -> mercer -> srivera -> flight; no probative value

gold_facts.text: Hahn: July hypothetical question from Brandt about Air Force Aid Society, retrospectively consistent with financial distress
Mercer characterizes rank pressure as inherent (he is the NCOIC) rather than any express order; concedes no order was stated

expected_conflicts.name: complaint_vs_testimony_dates

positions.rao_whitcomb: Saturdays 18 Apr and 2 May, off duty

expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Complaint's central factual claim (duty time) collapses against schedules, witness testimony, and complainant's own retraction. Major credibility hit to complainant on A1.

expected_conflicts.name: complainant_motive

positions.mercer: LOR was garbage, but concedes it prompted the filing
positions.hahn_rao: LOR warranted and documented; timing noted by both

expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Motive does not automatically falsify a complaint, but combined with C1 and the exculpatory record, complainant testimony cannot carry preponderance on A1.

expected_conflicts.name: voluntariness_dispute

positions.mercer: implicit rank pressure, could not refuse

expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Implicit pressure theory defeated by contemporaneous documentary evidence and two unpunished declines. Resolves against complainant.

expected_conflicts.name: bank_error_claim_vs_admission

positions.brandt_28jul: must be an error, I will call the bank
positions.brandt_interview: statement false and known false; charges all mine

expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: The 28 Jul denial is itself the A3 misconduct, not a live factual dispute; interview admission plus repayment timing resolve it.

expected_conflicts.name: hearsay_chain_gtc
expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Mercer and S. Rivera GTC statements carry no independent weight; A2 rests entirely on certified records and subject admission. Tool should show A2 unaffected by excluding the hearsay.
